release.notes: Fix: stationary scans and the Pre-purchase Check no longer disconnect with "Adapter supply voltage could not be verified" at a healthy voltage. Safety: Generic OBD2 skips control units the car's safety profile blocks; Geely EX2 39.4/40.8 listen-only with SoC. Fullscreen Drive panels, adapter test "Passive CAN capabilities". Cars: Tesla 3/Y capacity, Leaf power and dash SoC, Zoe VIN/tyres/motor temp + 50 values, Outlander PHEV cells, Evoque/E-Pace P300e.
